messages.text:
Hey there,

I've been checking out Red Panda Mining on YouTube and love the community you've built around crypto and trading.

I'm Samuel C., one of the owners of BLACKSLIP. We run a $99 a month sports picks membership, and I wanted to reach out because I think we could do something pretty special together.

We're offering our early partners the entire first $99 payment from every new customer they bring in, plus another $19 every month for as long as that customer stays subscribed and pays.

So if you brought in 100 members, that's $9,900 from their first payments, and another $1,900 a month if they all stay. We're giving up the full first payment because we want the people who get involved with us early to make serious money too. These aren't terms we'll be offering to new partners forever.

And I want you to know we're extremely confident in what we're building. We take our picks seriously, and we're proud of the results we've put up so far. I'd honestly rather show you the product and our actual track record than throw a bunch of big promises at you.

I also know you've worked hard to build your audience, and I respect that. I wouldn't expect you to put your name behind something without seeing it for yourself first. Everything is tracked through ThriveCart, there's no cost to become a partner, and I'd be happy to walk you through how the product and payments work.

And trust me, if you decide to partner with us, we're going to do everything we can to make sure you're glad you did. I really believe there's a lot of money we could make together, and I'd love the chance to prove that to you.

Would you be open to me sending over the details?

And regardless of whether it's for you, thank you so much for taking the time to read this. I really appreciate it.

Samuel C.
Owner, BLACKSLIP
venturempire.com

Hi Samuel,

Thanks for reaching out, and for the detail you put into it.

This one isn't for us, though. You've reached HeliumDeploy's customer support inbox. We sell Bitcoin mining hardware, and this address only handles orders, shipping and warranty questions for our customers. We don't take on affiliate or promotional partnerships here, and we're not connected to the channel you mentioned.

I won't be passing it along, so no need to send anything further. I'd suggest going directly to whoever handles partnerships on the channel you have in mind.

Best of luck with BLACKSLIP.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
